summary: King Nebuchadnezzar built a giant gold statue and ordered everyone to bow to it when the music played. Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego refused. They said God was able to rescue them, 'but even if He doesn't, we won't bow.'

story_reel.narration: King Nebuchadnezzar forgot what he had learned. He built an enormous statue made of gold. It was ninety feet tall! He called all the leaders of his kingdom to come and see it. Then a herald shouted: 'Listen, everyone! When you hear the sound of the horn, flute, harp, and all kinds of music, you must bow down and worship the golden statue. Anyone who doesn't bow will be thrown into a blazing furnace!' The music began to play, and everyone bowed down. Well, almost everyone. Three young men stood tall: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, Daniel's friends. Some officials ran to tell the king. Nebuchadnezzar was furious. He called the three friends in. 'Is it true you won't bow? I'll give you one more chance. If you don't bow, you'll be thrown into the furnace. And what god will be able to rescue you from my hand?' The three friends answered calmly: 'King Nebuchadnezzar, we don't need to defend ourselves. If we're thrown into the blazing furnace, the God we serve is able to rescue us, and He will rescue us from your hand. But even if He doesn't, we want you to know, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden statue.' That's real courage: trusting God no matter what happens.

identity_focus.core_truth: I can stand firm for Yahweh, trusting Him no matter what happens.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego said, 'Even if He doesn't, we won't bow.' When might you need to stand firm when everyone else is going along?
reflection_choices: When friends are doing something wrong
When people make fun of God

quiz.question: What did the king order everyone to do when the music played?
options: Bow down and worship the golden statue
quiz.explanation: When you hear the music, you shall fall down and worship the golden image.

quiz.question: What did the three friends say God was able to do?
quiz.explanation: They said, 'Our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace.'

quiz.question: What did they say they would do even if God didn't rescue them?
options: Not serve the king's gods or worship the statue
quiz.explanation: They said, 'But if not... we will not serve your gods, nor worship the golden image.'

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, You are able to rescue me. But even if things don't go the way I hope, I want to stand firm and trust You no matter what. Amen.

companion.message: 'Even if He doesn't.' Those are some of the bravest words in the Bible. I needed that kind of courage when it was my turn to stand before a king.
